notes: Soft gap: Pass@1 requires executing generated code against 1,140 unit-test suites in the released Docker-based harness, so the number is not checkable from the prompt alone. Table 4 (artifacts) has a garbled model-to-endpoint mapping in the extracted text (GPT-4o listed next to gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09), but Table 6 is unambiguous. Greedy decoding means seeds add little.

resolution.plan: Generate greedy completions for the 1,140 BigCodeBench-Complete tasks (huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/bigcodebench, v0.2.4) with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 using the Appendix K prompt format. Calibrated Pass@1 requires executing each completion against the task's unit tests inside the released Docker-based harness (bigcodebench package), which cannot be rebuilt from the paper text; the harness reports the calibrated score directly. Compare with 0.582 (Table 6).
